parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `AdaptiveQualityControllerTests.backgroundFlushesAnalytics` (line 110) and `AdaptiveQualityControllerTests.analyticsReceivesEvents` (line 189) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags.
